# `SelectCamera`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Notification that the selected imaging process (main or wide view) changed.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, SwitchProc @0x3c1a00 (64-bit build) |

Broadcast on TCP 4700 (channel I) when the process switch changes the selected imaging process. Family: custom; no state or error. APK consumers: DeviceEventPart; DeviceService app-state handler (route check disabled for this name).

Side effects: Observation only.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"SelectCamera"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `selected_cam` | string | yes | - | Process view name; unknown is the fallback for an unrecognized process type. One of: `View`, `SecondView`, `unknown`. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, switched-to-wide - READ shape, not captured:

```json
{"Event":"SelectCamera","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","selected_cam":"SecondView"}
```
